instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a medium shot captures a park setting with lush green foliage. The bearded man in a beige shirt (R2) stands in the center, smiling as he looks to the side. He carries the young child with curly hair (R1) on his shoulders. The young child, wearing an orange polo, smiles while looking down. The bearded man holds the young child's hands near his chest to secure him, with the child's legs draped over his shoulders. The scene is illuminated by soft, warm natural sunlight, creating a gentle and happy atmosphere.
